flawed_step: Step 2: Inferring P(|X_n-X| > eps) -> 0 from convergence of the marginal distribution functions.
assessment_summary: Step 1 is justified: convergence in distribution controls the marginal laws of X_n. The next required step is not justified because convergence in distribution gives no control over the joint dependence between X_n and X on their common probability space. Therefore it does not imply convergence in probability.
